verdict.rationale: Devin supports conversational debugging via chat (Ask Devin can repro/fix bugs, answer questions about code structure) and can be tagged in Slack/Teams threads about bugs, matching the natural-language debugging story. However, community evidence shows real friction: it can add extraneous changes it can't undo, and gets stuck running in circles rather than admitting failure, undermining reliability for troubleshooting. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of debugging accuracy/success rate, and clearer evidence of interactive back-and-forth troubleshooting depth beyond bug-fix requests.
